title: [FEATURE] adding support for effort tracking via OTEL
body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have searched [existing requests](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20label%3Aenhancement) and this feature hasn't been requested yet
- [x] This is a single feature request (not multiple features)

### Problem Statement

We are utilzing the otel collected usage metrics quite heavily for cost optimasation. 
However, as of today, `effort`is not beeing tracked. This would be really helpfull !

### Proposed Solution

Adding a new `effort` attribute as standard attribute. Much like `Model identifier` oder `type`
https://code.claude.com/docs/en/monitoring-usage#standard-attributes

top_comments.author: 0xbrainkid
top_comments.body:
OTEL-native effort tracking is a meaningful observability improvement — moving effort level from a `/status` text field to a structured OpenTelemetry span attribute makes it first-class in any observability backend that already consumes Claude Code traces.

From a behavioral trust and monitoring perspective, effort level is an important context attribute for interpreting trace data: a span with low effort producing a correct result is different from a high-effort span producing the same result —
